caption:
बॉलीवुड़ में रामायण फिल्म को लेकर चल रहा है गजब का क्रेज! 🔥
गुरुवार को Kaali Kheti के trailer लॉन्च पर एक्टर शरद केल्कर ने यश के लिए डबिंग करने के अपने अनुभव पर खुलकर बात की।
शरद केल्कर का कहना है कि यश के शानदार अभिनय की वजह से उनके लिए हिंदी version में डबिंग करना काफी मुशकिल रहा।
उन्होंने यश की तारीफ करते हुए कहा कि जैसा रोल उन्होंने किया है, वैसा कोई और नहीं कर सकता और वह एक brilliant actor हैं।
इसी event पर शरद ने फिल्म का एक डायलॉग अपने अंदाज में बोला कि तीनों लोकों में सिर्फ एक ही राज होगा, केल्कर राज।
दूसरी तरफ, यश का कहना है कि रावण का किरदार निभाना एक चुनौती थी क्योंकि लोग इस किरदार के बारे में पहले से जानते हैं और दर्शकों के मन में एक छवि होती है, जिससे एक्टर पर एक्स्ट्रा प्रेशर रहता है।
Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी इस फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor राम, Sai Pallavi सीता और यश रावण के रोल में नजर आ रहे हैं।
फिल्म ने गुरुवार को worldwide box office collections में 1000 करोड़ रुपए का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है। 💰

ctx.title: Sharad Kelkar says dubbing for Yash's Ravana in Ramayana was difficult because of his 'phenomenal' performance
ctx.summary: Sharad Kelkar says dubbing Yash’s Ravana in the Hindi version of Ramayana was difficult because of the actor’s phenomenal performance.
ctx.text:
Actor Sharad Kelkar , who has been receiving appreciation for dubbing Yash's voice in the Hindi version of Ramayana , recently spoke about his experience working on the film. Speaking at the trailer launch of Kaali Kheti on Thursday, Sharad thanked the audience for their praise but admitted that dubbing for Yash was a little challenging because of the actor's phenomenal performance.
At the trailer launch, when he was praised for his dubbing, Sharad smiled and delivered one of Yash's dialogues from the film, but with his own twist - “Teeno lokon mein sirf ek hi raj hoga, Kelkar raj (There shall be only one rule across the three worlds: the Kelkar rule).”
He went on to praise Yash for his performance as Ravana, saying, “I must give compliment to Yash. The way he has performed in the film, I think nobody could have done it. He is such a brilliant actor. Jis tarah se unhone kiya hai woh role (The way he has performed that role), I think he is phenomenal. Isliye unko itna appreciation mil raha hai film ke andar (I think that is why he is getting so much appreciation).”
Sharad also admitted that dubbing for Yash was not easy, given how well he had performed the role. “Mere ko thodi mushkil hui dub karne mein woh (I had some difficulty doing that), because he was so good in the film. But, thank you, you all loved the film, and loved the voice,” he added.
A post shared by Press Trust of India (PTI) (@ptinews_multimedia)
Earlier, while speaking to IGN, Yash spoke about the pressure of playing Ravana. He said, “If you know the character and everybody is aware of it, then it becomes challenging. If it's a new film where you are telling a new story, whatever you do, that will become the character. But if people already have some image about it since so many people have played it in different ways, then it's extra pressure for an actor. But I stuck to very simple basics to understand what made him do such kind of things. The intent was important.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The film is co-produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios and DNEG, along with Yash's Monster Mind Creations. On Thursday, the film crossed ₹ 1,000 crore in worldwide box office collections.
